subject: Reconciling unit-rate targets — $/1M benchmarking vs host alternatives
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@medbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reconciling unit-rate targets — $/1M benchmarking vs host alternatives

Hi Alicia — great product demo earlier. Quick recap + asks from our side so we can finalize an apples-to-apples price comparison and propose a pilot: 

Summary from call:
- Expected production traffic (monthly active users and avg tokens per interaction): you mentioned ~1.2M sessions/mo with ~750 tokens/session on average (~900M tokens/mo).
- Near-term pilot baseline: 10–20M tokens over first 30 days to validate latency and quality.
- Primary technical constraint: data residency inside US east and row-level audit logs.

Open asks to finalize our benchmarking and pricing sheet: 
1) Please confirm whether the 1.2M sessions estimate is monthly or weekly; we used monthly above.
2) Confirm target $/1M tokens range you’d consider for procurement (ballpark is fine: e.g., $X–$Y per 1M).
3) Any vendor mandates (OpenAI/Anthropic acceptance, or must be self-hosted/open-model?)

What we’ll deliver once we have your answers: 
- A target comparison showing Redwood vs OpenAI vs Anthropic vs two common open-model hosts (quantized variants included) at the volumes you provided.
- A recommended pilot proposal with expected cost and SLA targets and an explicit fallback plan if we need to use smaller-context or quantized variants.

I attached a quick template for the volume profile and a placeholder benchmarking sheet we’ll populate. If you’re ok, we’ll aim to send you a completed comparison by EOD Thursday PST.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: medbridge_volume_profile.csv (CSV), redwood_1M_benchmarks.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@medbridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reconciling unit-rate targets — $/1M benchmarking vs host alternatives

Thanks, Logan — quick clarifications below.

1) 1.2M sessions is monthly; apologies for the shorthand on the call.
2) Budget guidance: for enterprise procurement we’re targeting $/1M in the $700–$1,000 range as our preferred band. Lower is better but we need predictable SLOs and auditability. For the pilot, procurement would accept up to $1,200/1M if it accelerates time-to-value.
3) Vendor constraints: procurement will accept hosted vendors but requires documented SOC 2 + runtime audit logs and a contractual clause prohibiting model fine-tuning on our data. Open-model self-hosted is acceptable but increases procurement friction.

Pilot notes: we’ll aim for a 30-day pilot at 15M tokens (ingestion + inference) and a go/no-go decision at the end. Will loop in procurement in the next message.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product, MedBridge Health
alicia.gomez@medbridge.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@medbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@medbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reconciling unit-rate targets — $/1M benchmarking vs host alternatives

Thanks for the fast reply and the budget band — that helps a lot. Looping procurement into thread. 

Ben / Kim — action items for Redwood: 
- Ben: populate the attached benchmarking sheet with a conservative and an aggressive row for each vendor (OpenAI, Anthropic, Redwood-hosted, Redwood-dedicated quantized variant, Host X open-model). Include token-only costs, estimated infra uplift for audit logs, and any per-request inference overheads (e.g., function-calling or streaming).
- Kim: prepare a one-page pilot commercial term we can present to procurement: 15M tokens, fixed pilot unit price, 14-day termination window, SOC 2 attestation, and explicit no-fine-tune clause. Also outline what audit logs look like (retention, fields).

We’ll aim to return the populated sheet + pilot term sheet by Thu EOD PST as promised. Alicia — based on your pilot acceptance criteria ($700–$1,200 band), we’ll try to show scenarios where Redwood can meet $700/1M at scale (dedicated + caching) and a conservative hosted price near $1,000–$1,100/1M for the pilot. If procurement needs a lower commitment, we can show a 12-month reserved commit that brings price down and an opt-out cadence.

Logan
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia@medbridge.com>, procurement <procurement@medbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reconciling unit-rate targets — $/1M benchmarking vs host alternatives

Quick benchmark notes (high level) — I’ll add the full breakdown in redwood_1M_benchmarks.xlsx and share the Drive link once done: 

- OpenAI (gpt-4.1/4o equivalents): $1,100–$1,400 per 1M effective tokens (depends on context window & function-calling).
- Anthropic (Claude-like): $900–$1,200 per 1M.
- Typical open-model hosts (quantized Llama-family variants): $350–$750 per 1M at high volumes but requires dedicated infra + ops for SLO/audit.
- Redwood-hosted (standard): pilot estimate $950–$1,050 per 1M with SOC 2 and logs included; can drop to ~$650–$750 per 1M on dedicated/reserved 12-mo commits + caching/KV reuse.
- Notes on comparability: effective $/1M depends heavily on avg tokens/session, prefix reuse, and how many requests are streamed vs. fully buffered. We include assumptions in the spreadsheet.

Next steps: I’ll populate the spreadsheet with three scenarios (pilot, steady-state conservative, steady-state optimized). Kimberly will attach the one-page pilot commercial. Alicia / procurement — if you can share an internal procurement contact and an SLA minimal checklist we’ll mirror those items into the pilot T&Cs.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood_1M_benchmarks.xlsx (will be uploaded to Drive), medbridge_volume_profile.csv (provided by Alicia)
